display_name: MSIG Vietnam General Liability Insurance Policy (Revised CGL Policy Form, 12 January 2015): the whole document — the Comprehensive General Liability and the Products and Completed Operations coverage parts, the conditions, the definitions and every Special Condition

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: The source is English only: it contains no Vietnamese and no Vietnamese counterpart was found. Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en); `-- src:N |` comments quote the English source, generated by tools/vnsrc.py from line N of ../../source/raw/msig-cgl.txt. The Vietnamese in GLOSSARY.md is the encoder's translation, marked [translator] on every line that carries it.

documents.authority: the insurer's standard form as published at its URL on the retrieval date

aids.note: Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15, read only to record LAW forks; not encoded. The aid file ends at Article 130.

scope: The whole document, src:1-989: recital and agreement (inert), COVERAGE, SUPPLEMENTARY PAYMENTS, APPLICABLE LAW (inert), JURISDICTION, the sixteen DEFINITIONS, CONDITIONS 1-10, the Comprehensive General Liability Insurance Coverage Part (I and exclusions (a)-(q), II, III, IV), the Products and Completed Operations Liability Insurance Coverage Part (I and exclusions (a)-(i), II, III, IV), every Special Condition, and the closing notice (inert). Declined by name: the premium under the Company's rules and the short rate table, neither of which is in the document. Inputs, with no default: everything the declarations, the schedule and the Company's manual hold. Out of scope: none. Deferred: none. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: The policy period is inclusive of both stated days.
forks.F2: The policy territory proviso qualifies all three limbs and bites only where a suit is brought, which must be in a Vietnamese court; the Jurisdiction clause reaches judgements only.
forks.F3: 'named insured products' and 'named insured's products' are one term.
forks.F4: The Ultimate Net Loss Clause (S$ caps) is operative over Supplementary Payments (US$ caps); LAW: Law Art. 24 would favour the larger cap, not encoded.
forks.F5: The rate converting the US$ and S$ caps to dong is an input; the limits are read as dong.
forks.F6: 'the insured' in an exclusion is the insured the claim is made against.
forks.F7: The CGL part's undesignated-partnership sentence applies to the whole part, not paragraph (e) only.
forks.F8: Persons Insured (e)(ii): a person legally responsible for the operation needs the same registration and permission.
forks.F9: The spouse is an insured only where the named insured is an individual.
forks.F10: The Combined Single Limit Endorsement governs where the schedule states one combined sum; III as printed governs where it states separate sums.
forks.F11: Under separate limits the supplementary sums follow the one kind of harm, or the kind alleged; an occurrence with both kinds and supplementary sums is declined.
forks.F12: 'as soon as practicable', 'immediately', 'promptly' are standards, carried as findings; no period is invented.
forks.F13: Condition 2's three years are calendar years, the anniversary included.
forks.F14: Condition 4's 'full compliance' is read literally; LAW: Law Art. 46 and Art. 19(3), not resolved.
forks.F15: Condition 5 contributes only with insurance on the same basis; an excess or contingent policy against another basis is declined.
forks.F16: Condition 9's ten days are calendar days from mailing, the tenth day allowed.
forks.F17: Pro rata is days elapsed over days in the period.
forks.F18: Special Conditions reach the parts their headings name; the Claims Made Basis Endorsement and the Claim Series Clause reach the P&CO part only.
forks.F19: The Completed Operations Hazard and Products Hazard Exclusion Clause reaches harm within the hazards as defined.
forks.F20: The claims-made trigger is added to, and does not replace, the occurrence-in-period definitions.
forks.F21: 'sustained after the Retroactive Date' is strict.
forks.F22: 'did not know or could not reasonably have foreseen' is read as written (a disjunction).
forks.F23: 120 months are calendar months, the end day included.
forks.F24: A Claim Series Event's deemed date of occurrence also dates the harm for the policy period test.
forks.F25: Clause 4 deeming needs first awareness and notice in the period and a claim from the notified products.
forks.F26: Once the Company alleges the War and Terrorism Exclusion, the loss is excluded unless the insured has proved the contrary.
forks.F27: The Sanction clause is applied to the whole claim.
forks.F28: 'liability under a written sidetrack agreement' is liability assumed under one.
forks.F29: Liquor exclusion part (ii) does not reach an owner or lessor under (2).
forks.F30: Sistership 2 reaches later harm from the same cause as the initial harm.
forks.F31: LAW: the consequences of a misstatement are the Law's (Art. 22); not encoded.
forks.F32: A vehicle that is both a road vehicle and mobile equipment is mobile equipment.
forks.F33: The Punitive Damages Exclusion removes an amount, not the claim.
forks.F34: First aid counts only for a covered claim.
forks.F35: LAW: Condition 9's cancellation at will against Law Art. 26; not resolved.
forks.F36: LAW: claim dossier and payment deadlines come from Law Art. 30-31; not encoded.
forks.F37: LAW: whether Law Art. 54(3) reaches a liability policy; not resolved.
forks.F38: LAW: Condition 4's claimant right against Law Art. 58(2); not resolved.
forks.F39: LAW: Law Art. 19(2) explanation of exclusions is a fact outside the document; not encoded.
forks.F40: Every Special Condition is part of the Policy whether or not the declarations list it.
